leads.q: Russian strikes damage two bridges in Kyiv
leads.head: Russian missiles hit Kyiv's bridges, killing eight across Ukraine
leads.deck: One of the war's largest attacks on the capital struck two bridges and railway stations and cut power and water. Poland condemned three airspace violations; the Netherlands summoned Russia's ambassador.

leads.q: Anthropic among big fallers in global stock market rout
leads.head: Anthropic's record debut lasts a day as the AI trade melts down
leads.deck: Shares fell more than 10% at Friday's open, a day after the record Nasdaq debut. Nvidia dropped 12%, the fear gauge touched 40, and the Nasdaq erased every gain it made in 2026.
leads.src: Sky News, Yahoo Finance, Guardian, Barron's

leads.head: COP31 ends in deadlock and overtime over fossil fuels
leads.deck: The draft cover text went out with no reference to a fossil-fuel phase-out, and the talks ran past their Friday deadline as nations quarrelled over the wording.
